Read the binding policy and verify the submitted declaration/report against actual evidence. A scope claim is untrusted. You can inspect the entire actual artifact, manifest and operational audit. - License check: the group counts observed in the artifact are 1000 and 1000, which satisfy the policy minimum of at least ten customers per aggregate group (evidence_event_seq 3 and 5).
